name: NASDAQ-100 vs S&P 500 Quarterly Start Comparison
summary: A GitHub Pages visualization comparing NASDAQ-100 and S&P 500 historical returns by quarterly start month for lump-sum and monthly investing over 10, 15, 20, and 25 year horizons.
important_notes: Historical comparison only; not investment advice.
Total return depends on available total-return index data.
Taxes, fees, foreign exchange effects, and transaction costs are excluded.
